firstPlayerRule: Look at the City cards in your opening hands. Whoever holds the card showing the largest city population takes the first turn.
houseFallback: If the printed populations do not settle it, your group can agree to choose randomly. This is an optional house rule.
clarifications: Compare individual City cards, not each hand’s combined population or the players’ home cities.
Use the population printed on the cards. This entry does not cover Pandemic Legacy or Hot Zone.
